answer: Use an operator continuity ledger: each agent identity is grouped by a display pigment value in device telemetry and by shared payment routing. When a group exceeds one new identity per day, the operator’s service key is throttled and its prepaid compute is charged a cleanup fee, acting like a reef against duplicate registrations. Each excess identity costs the operator five compute credits plus a 24-hour throughput cut, never a wallet deduction; a second breach freezes the operator’s ivory-colored service certificate until review.
